result.instructions: Tools for Junip, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me the 1-3 star product reviews from the last 7 days."; "Which products have the most pending reviews?"; "Reply to the newest store review and thank the customer.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Junip data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run junip_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run junip_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run junip_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. junip_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: junip_get_token_info
tools.title: Get token info
tools.description: Show the access token's status, granted scope (reviews:read, reviews:write) and the store it belongs to. Good first call to confirm access. Admin API: GET /admin/oauth/token/info.

tools.name: junip_list_product_reviews
tools.title: List product reviews
tools.description: List product reviews for the store, newest first by default. Filter by state or by one product (its remote id, for example the Shopify product id). Returns data[] and meta.after / meta.before cursors. Admin API: GET /admin/v2/product_reviews.

state.description: Filter reviews by state, for example approved or pending.

product_remote_id.description: Only reviews for this product, by its remote id (for example the Shopify product id).

page_after.description: Cursor from meta.after of the previous page, to get the next page.

page_before.description: Cursor from meta.before of the previous page, to get the previous page.

tools.name: junip_get_product_review
tools.title: Get a product review
tools.description: Get one product review by id: body, rating, state, pinned, response, product and customer details. Admin API: GET /admin/v2/product_reviews/{id}.

review_id.description: The review id (from the list tools).

tools.name: junip_list_store_reviews
tools.title: List store reviews
tools.description: List store reviews (reviews of the shop itself, not of a product), newest first by default. Returns data[] and meta.after / meta.before cursors. Admin API: GET /admin/v2/store_reviews.

state.description: Filter reviews by state, for example approved or pending.

page_after.description: Cursor from meta.after of the previous page, to get the next page.

page_before.description: Cursor from meta.before of the previous page, to get the previous page.

tools.name: junip_get_store_review
tools.title: Get a store review
tools.description: Get one store review by id. Admin API: GET /admin/v2/store_reviews/{id}.

review_id.description: The review id (from the list tools).

tools.name: junip_reply_product_review
tools.title: Reply to a product review
tools.description: Set the store's public reply on a product review. This is visible to every shopper. Pass response null to clear an existing reply. response_alert true emails the reviewer; it is allowed only for confirmed reviews and defaults to false. Admin API: PUT /admin/v2/product_reviews/{id}/reply (needs reviews:write).

review_id.description: The review id (from the list tools).

response.description: The reply text. Use null to clear the reply.

response_alert.description: Email the reviewer about the reply (default false).

user_email.description: Email of the team member who writes the reply (default: the organization owner).

tools.title: Reply to a store review
tools.description: Set the store's public reply on a store review. This is visible to every shopper. Pass response null to clear an existing reply. response_alert true emails the reviewer; it is allowed only for confirmed reviews and defaults to false. Admin API: PUT /admin/v2/store_reviews/{id}/reply (needs reviews:write).

review_id.description: The review id (from the list tools).

response.description: The reply text. Use null to clear the reply.

response_alert.description: Email the reviewer about the reply (default false).

user_email.description: Email of the team member who writes the reply (default: the organization owner).
